description: This file defines the ReportToDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Entity\Decorator namespace. It provides methods to set supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method details for ReportTo entities, utilizing traits and references to other entities such as Employee and ReportingMethod.

classes.name: ReportToDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for handling ReportTo entity operations, such as assigning supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method by their identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decorator with a ReportTo entity object.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportTo
methods.description: Returns the associated ReportTo entity object.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee for the report-to relationship using an employee number.

methods.name: setSubordinateEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee for the report-to relationship using an employee number.

methods.name: setReportingMethodByReportingMethodId
methods.description: Sets the reporting method for the report-to relationship using a reporting method ID.
